task: Measure critical instruction-surface behavior in Codex and Antigravity against a zero-injection control
problem: Prove that host-native instruction loading changes behavior without adding another paid evaluation provider or claiming success from configuration presence.

evidence: Codex CLI 0.145.0 provides ephemeral read-only exec with output schemas
Antigravity CLI 1.1.13 provides sandboxed plan-mode print with JSON Schema and stream-json
the repository already contains native generated adapters and an existing safe subprocess pattern to adapt

finalists.name: Small repository runner over native authenticated host CLIs

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Yes; both hosts ran the same ten cases against zero injection and the portable kernel.
functional_fit.unnecessary_features: No provider abstraction, dashboard, task database, or model judge.

project_fit.compatible_with_current_stack: Uses existing Codex, Antigravity, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, and generated rules.
project_fit.integration_surface: One case file, one runner, one deterministic result checker.

maturity.release_recency: Codex 0.145.0 and Antigravity 1.1.13 were probed on 2026-08-14.
maturity.maintenance_activity: Both host CLIs are actively maintained.
maturity.issue_health: Official host issue trackers are available.
maturity.documentation_quality: Local help and official Antigravity CLI documentation cover the invoked flags.
maturity.tests: Ten same-case canaries plus A0→V0 subagent smoke.
maturity.production_usage_signal: Runs only in temporary repositories and sandboxed/read-only modes.

security.permissions_required: Read-only Codex sandbox and Antigravity sandboxed plan mode.
security.secret_handling: Uses existing authenticated sessions without reading credentials.
security.network_access: Only the existing host inference services.

ownership.maintainer_bus_factor: Same ownership as the host compiler.
ownership.upgrade_cost: Revalidate CLI flags and output envelopes on version change.
ownership.lock_in: Each host adapter is narrow and explicit.
ownership.exit_strategy: Replace one adapter or wrap it with a future accepted evaluation runner.

operations.runtime_cost: Two inference calls per host for a full live comparison.
operations.observability: JSON results include versions, exact SHA, case grades, latency, and Antigravity usage.

engineering_cost.adaptation_cost: Small cross-platform launcher resolution and host envelope parsing.
engineering_cost.long_term_maintenance_cost: Low if kept to native host canaries.

agent_fit.context7_support: Not required; local help and official host docs are authoritative.
agent_fit.machine_verifiable: Yes; schema output and deterministic grading.
agent_fit.deterministic_testability: Grading is deterministic; model behavior is recorded as the evaluated subject.
